title: Run Snapshot v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Durable, replayable snapshot of one run at a committed event cursor. methodology, autonomy_policy and session_schedule are three distinct required fields and must never be conflated into one mode string. process_identity is a native handle object issued by the trusted run service; a model-authored string is not a native handle and will fail validation. authority_decision_digest identifies the trusted-service decision that admitted the snapshot. NOTE: this schema validates untrusted wire data only. It does not authenticate the issuer; the runtime must obtain the authenticated principal from the trusted service seam.

schema_version.description: Wire-contract version. Unknown versions fail closed.

version.description: Monotonic snapshot revision, not the wire-contract version.

state.description: Lifecycle state; the value set is owned by the shared run-state contract.

methodology.description: Methodology field. Distinct from autonomy_policy and session_schedule.

autonomy_policy.description: Autonomy policy field. Distinct from methodology and session_schedule.

session_schedule.description: Session schedule field. Distinct from methodology and autonomy_policy; a schedule never implies an autonomy grant.

process_identity.description: Native process handle issued by the trusted run service. A model-authored string is not a native handle.

authority_decision_digest.description: Digest of the trusted-service authority decision that admitted this snapshot. Not attestation by itself.

handle_id.description: Opaque handle identifier issued by a trusted native service.

service_principal.description: Authenticated principal of the trusted service that issued the handle. Wire-recorded here; authentication happens at the service seam.
